0022600184.text: The Mavericks (4-3) visit the Spurs (5-2) for their eighth game of the season, coming off a loss and sitting 9th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, while San Antonio has won five straight and is 6th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back. Dallas is 2-1 on the road and San Antonio is 3-2 at home, and the Mavericks trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 122-106 loss in Dallas on October 24, following a 0-4 record against San Antonio in 2025-26. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), while Kyrie Irving (knee) and Max Christie (hip) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain).
